pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions. Edges exhibit sharp pixel-level transitions with moderate angularity. Patches occupy the majority of the spatial area relative to the light separators.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored linear pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections. Pathway width is narrow and relatively uniform across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour along the upper neck and shoulder ridge against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A notable structural dip and reduction in mane height is visible at the junction between the neck and the shoulder.
